formal_object.rationale: R is an orthonormal protected query basis; Delta acts on query rows of a raw bilinear score.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: D01: Every feasible update is Delta=P Z. Condition: R is an orthonormal basis C04: Only q_perp contributes and controls drift. Condition: Use the same fixed raw score on both arms

derivation.rationale: R^T Delta=0 iff Delta=(I-RR^T)Z; q^T Delta c vanishes on the span, and the residual Cauchy-Schwarz bound retains ||Pq||.

assumptions.rationale: R^T R=I and P is fixed from fitting data. Protection means raw bilinear logits, not renormalized embeddings or whole-task accuracy. Candidate inputs, pooling and score temperature do not change. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: The projected-gradient construction preserves the constraint only with fixed R and no incompatible score renormalization; rank-eight training span is a limited surrogate.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: At equal update norm, raw score drift is zero on protected span and bounded proportionally to query distance from that span. This does not assert whole-group preservation. Falsification: Nonzero protected-span score drift refutes the implementation. No better drift/quality tradeoff than an unconstrained ridge/trust-region control defeats necessity.

closest_alternative.rationale: PCGrad changes directions using current conflicting gradients; a fixed query-space constraint preserves a different quantity. Unconstrained matched KD is also required.
